votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the January 17, 2013 meeting as presented.
votes.quote: on a motion by elizabeth murphy, seconded by paul doherty; the minutes were approved as presented. all were in favor.

votes.motion: Award the bid for the parking lot resurfacing at the 667-1 elderly development to the lowest bidder, Sunshine Paving Corporation, in the amount of $72,000.00 (Resolution 201307).
votes.quote: elizabeth murphy seconded the motion and the motion was passed by a unanimous vote.

votes.motion: Authorize the Chair or the Executive Director to sign Change Order Number One to the designer fee contract (Graves Engineering), increasing it by $5,000.00 (Resolution 201308).
votes.quote: paul doherty seconded the motion, and the motion was passed unanimously.
with no other business, on a motion by deborah a.h. christen, seconded by elizabeth murphy, the board voted to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 pm. all were in favor.
